tasks.prompt: Summarise what has to be true before FareLoop 4.12 is submitted to the stores and before the Android rollout can go past its early stages.

rubric.text: Store submission is planned for Wednesday 2026-11-11, not 2026-11-04.
Both blockers (offline ticket cache fix, Android crash rate) must be closed; if they are by 2026-11-10 the board can approve by message.
At least 1,000 active beta users for a full 48 hours before submission.
The Android crash-free sessions gate is 99.6% (beta is at 99.41%).
The Android rollout goes 5%, 20%, 50%, 100% and must not pass 20% until crash-free sessions stay at or above 99.6% for 48 hours in a row.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Status at a glance, Release plan, Rollout rules, Decisions this week.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b
tasks.prompt: Explain what a FareLoop 4.12 rider can and cannot do with tickets and passes while the phone has no network connection.

rubric.text: Buying a ticket offline is not supported; riders must be online to buy.
Monthly pass holders are the exception: they can renew a pass offline, confirmed when the phone next connects.
A ticket bought online can be shown offline for up to 72 hours, after which the app asks the rider to reconnect.
